# Finkelstein Lab

> The lab of Ilya J. Finkelstein, Professor of Molecular Biosciences at UT Austin. Builds single-molecule and high-throughput biophysical methods (DNA curtains, CHAMP/NGS-chip repurposing, microfluidic single-cell arrays) to study how molecular machines edit and repair genomes: CRISPR-Cas adaptive immunity and nuclease engineering, eukaryotic DNA double-strand-break repair and homologous recombination, mismatch repair, retron-based genome editing, and biosensing. Also expert-witness and technical consulting in biotechnology and gene-editing patent matters.
